corning.title: IT Intern [Network Analyst]
corning.description: Monitor and troubleshoot enterprise network connectivity, performance, and security-related issues to support reliable IT operations. Assist with wireless network configuration, access point monitoring, and connectivity validation across enterprise environments. Built a Power Automate workflow to process ISP vendor maintenance notifications, update tracking records, and notify the team. Document technical issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions to improve operational consistency and knowledge sharing.

cyberSecured.title: Cybersecurity and Digital Forensics Intern
cyberSecured.description: Supported cybersecurity and digital forensics investigations through artifact review, log analysis, and evidence collection. Used tools such as Autopsy, FTK Imager, and Wireshark to support investigative workflows and technical analysis. Documented findings and contributed to reports for security assessments and forensic investigations.

ispAutomation.title: ISP Vendor Maintenance Notification Automation
ispAutomation.tagline: A Power Automate workflow for ISP vendor maintenance email notifications.
ispAutomation.description: Built a Power Automate workflow to process ISP vendor maintenance email notifications and automate repeatable tracking tasks. Parsed incoming email content, extracted maintenance details, updated tracking records, and notified the team for timely follow-up.

intrusionDetection.title: Machine Learning-Based Intrusion Detection System
intrusionDetection.tagline: Real-time intrusion detection with a Random Forest model, Flask, and AWS.
intrusionDetection.description: Built a real-time intrusion detection system using a Random Forest model to identify suspicious network traffic with 95% accuracy. Developed a Flask-based interface and deployed the solution on AWS to support scalable AI-assisted security monitoring.

endpointLab.description: Conducted a controlled lab analysis of input-capture behavior to understand endpoint monitoring, detection, and defensive security concepts.
